days.title: Geothermal Features and Hot Springs
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Bláhver
stops.detail: So there are hot springs here, such as the Bláhver (German "Blue Spring") surrounded by sinter terraces, fumaroles, and the hissing solfatara Öskurhöll (German "Roaring Hill").

stops.name: Bræðrahver
stops.detail: Bræðrahver and Eyvinderhver are small geysers.

stops.name: Thermalbad
stops.detail: In addition, the area offers a thermal bath with a natural rock basin of about 25 square meters and an inlet temperature of over 80 degrees, which is mixed down to well below 40 degrees, as well as several hiking trails.

stops.name: Eyvindar-Kofi
stops.detail: A cave-like hut, Eyvindar-Kofi, can still be visited.

stops.name: Eyvindar-Rétt
stops.detail: In addition, the remains of a sheep pen, Eyvindar-Rétt, are named after him.
